title: PJM Interim Resource Adequacy Service & Large Load Registry — FERC 205(d) effective date (docket ER26-3515)
source: EST: govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-08-19/html/2026-16927.htm (Combined Notice of Filings #1, re-fetched direct 2026-09-15, HTTP 200) reads verbatim 'PJM Interconnection, L.L.C.', docket 'ER26-3515-000', '205(d) Rate Filing: Proposal to Establish Interim Resource Adequacy Service & a Large Load Registry to be effective 10/12/2026', filed date 8/13/26, accession 20260813-5118, comments due 5 p.m. ET 9/3/26. The identical entry appears one day earlier in FR-2026-08-18 notice 2026-16808 (Combined Notice of Filings #2, fetched direct 2026-09-15), so two independent Federal Register publications carry the same docket, filing date, accession and effective date. The federalregister.gov API (term=ER26-3515, publication_date >= 2026-08-01, queried 2026-09-15) returns count 2 — exactly those two notices and NO order, notice of deficiency, suspension or acceptance. Corroborated on mechanics and on the requested deadline by powermag.com/pjm-widens-response-to-data-center-load-as-capacity-shortfalls-deepen/ (2026-08-20) and datacenterknowledge.com/energy-power-supply/pjm-s-new-deal-for-data-centers-bring-power-or-face-cuts (both fetched 2026-09-15): the TARIFF revisions are requested effective 2026-10-12; the SERVICE itself does not bind until 2027-06-01, and the capacity-auction demand-curve change not until the 2029/30 delivery year. Stays `estimate` on two counts. (1) market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no member for FERC — `PJM:` is scoped to 'pjm.com auction schedule', and this is a FERC docket date, not an auction. (2) 2026-10-12 is a REQUESTED effective date on a filing both PJM's Independent Market Monitor and EPSA asked FERC to reject outright (both protests dated 2026-09-03); it becomes operative only by the FPA section 205(d) default that a filing FERC does not reject, suspend or set for hearing takes effect on its requested date. No FERC order in ER26-3515 was found on any search or API query run 2026-09-15 — recorded as an ABSENCE, not a denial, because elibrary.ferc.gov serves no document list to a plain fetcher and ferc.gov itself returns 403 (Cloudflare interstitial) to this runner. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-09-15 by this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/pjm-iras-ferc-deadline-2026-10-12.md) from the sole proposal, `proposals/pjm-iras-ferc-deadline-2026-10-12.from-pjm-reliability-backstop-procurement-2026-09-30.json` (now shadowed, left in place). WHAT THE DAY IS: the requested effective date of PJM's second large-load tariff intervention in six weeks — Interim Resource Adequacy Service plus a Large Load Registry. A 'New Large Load' is end-use demand with a cumulative peak of at least 50 MW at a single electrical site (affiliates within one mile aggregate) entering service after 2027-06-01; a New Large Load that does not Bring Your Own New Capacity is curtailed BEFORE PJM calls Pre-Emergency Load Management, at a maximum wholesale rate of 50% of PJM's Non-Performance Charge Rate, with retail funding left to the states; from the 2029/30 delivery year uncovered incremental new large-load demand is excluded from the capacity-auction demand curve. THREE THINGS THE PROPOSAL DID NOT HAVE, all added here. (1) THE OPERATIVE DEADLINE IS 2026-10-09, NOT 10-12: 2026-10-12 is Columbus Day, a federal holiday the Federal Reserve's own K.8 schedule lists verbatim for 2026 (read via sifma-bond-market-closure-2026-10-12's primary-sourced entry on this same calendar), so FERC's last business day to reject, suspend or set the filing for hearing is Friday 2026-10-09 — this lane's inference from the holiday, not a claim any source makes. (2) THE OPEN-MEETING CHANNEL IS CLOSED, AND THAT PROVES LESS HERE THAN THE SIBLING LEDGER READ IT TO PROVE: FERC's September open meeting (2026-09-10) carried no PJM item, the federalregister.gov API returns exactly one FERC Sunshine Act notice published since 2026-09-01 (2026-18361, the 09-10 meeting), and the announced October meeting falls after 10-12 — but the Commission votes notationally on most business days, so a Commission-level order needs no agenda slot and 'delegated authority only' overstates it. (3) THE PROTEST IS READ, NOT RELAYED: the IMM protest PDF the proposing ledger recorded as PDF_UNPARSED was decompressed and read this session (94,847 chars of text) — it asks FERC to reject the IRAS Filing in its entirety AND to open a new FPA section 206 proceeding, and it cites FERC's own 2026-06-18 large-load show-cause order to PJM (195 FERC para 61,211, Docket EL26-67) as the standard the filing fails. EL26-67 is a SEPARATE live docket with its own PJM response filed 2026-08-17 — the 08-13 IRAS filing is not that response. Impact medium and symbols EMPTY, deliberately: unlike the RBP this rule binds the DEMAND side, which is where this calendar's tracked names live (MSFT, META, GOOG, AMZN as PJM data-center hosts; CRWV as the most levered), but 10-12 publishes no number, the service does not bind until 2027-06-01, and a 5%-move screen on five mega-caps would fire on everything except this docket. The exposure is thesis-level and belongs to docs/research/ai-energy-constraint.md, not to a date-keyed row. Estimate throughout — a requested effective date on a filing two parties asked FERC to reject licenses no date-keyed entry.
